accepted_gaps.description: No sufficiently validated comparison of diagnosis-only, symptom-dimensional, and multimodal transdiagnostic response prediction across sites.
Inflammation and network dysconnectivity likely define subgroups, but subgroup boundaries and transportability remain unresolved.
Treatment response is heterogeneous, modality-specific, and time-varying; durability and early switching need joint modeling.
Biomarker associations are often not separated from clinical utility, fairness, and safety evidence.
The operational boundary between algorithmic recommendation and clinician-governed adaptation remains under-specified.

rejected_or_deferred_claims: One biomarker diagnoses all depression, schizophrenia, or anxiety.
A model can replace a psychiatrist or psychologist.
An association between a brain feature and symptoms proves mechanism.
Closed-loop treatment is ready for unsupervised clinical deployment.
